title: AI × Bio 每日精选
subtitle: 计算生物学、组学、蛋白质与生物医学模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】MM-KG把患者的文本、影像、基因组和生物样本证据与生物医学知识图谱显式对齐，并在MIMIC-IV和ADNI上验证可追溯检索。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时处理患者证据、外部知识及二者交互，且通过删除答案关系进行可解释性干预；结果支持“显式关系”而非静态背景知识的临床LLM用法，但仍属于离线数据评估。
items.abstract_zh: 临床问题往往需要将患者的多模态证据与外部生物医学知识连接起来，但现有预测系统很少显式表示这种连接，因此既无法追溯证据来源，也无法移除这些连接来测量其贡献。我们提出MM-KG（Multimodal Knowledge Graph，多模态知识图谱），在一个类型化图中将异质的多模态患者观察和生物医学概念表示为分离的层，并通过显式对齐边连接起来。首先，针对不同模态的协调器将EHR文本、影像、基因组和生物样本数据转换为类型化观察，并映射到UMLS概念；随后，路线优先的对齐器将这些观察连接到生物医学知识图谱。查询条件化检索接着选择一个紧凑子图，供下游大型语言模型或图神经网络使用。我们为MIMIC-IV和ADNI构建了MM-KG，并采用2×2设计进行评估，以区分患者证据、生物医学知识及其交互。在需要两类来源的问题上，单独使用任一来源的表现都没有远高于机会水平，而二者结合后，在药物控制的AUROC交互项上，MIMIC提高了+0.194，ADNI提高了+0.299。在留出的五候选排序任务中，MM-KG比MindMap高出+0.131 Hits@1，并在需要查阅患者信息的条目上领先改造后的GraphCare；删除检索数据包中唯一承载答案的关系后，Hits@1回落到无知识基线。最后，查询条件化检索达到0.731 AUROC，所需上下文比最强的通用策略少6.8倍；相比之下，静态知识图谱上下文在普通结局预测上没有一致收益。因此，知识图谱对临床LLM的价值不在于充当背景上下文，而在于作为患者多模态证据与问题所需关系之间的显式连接；MM-KG使这些连接可检索、可追溯且可测试。
items.author_line: Jiawen Du, Arshan Ali Khan, Chenhao Zhang, Zachary Plotkin, Li Shen, Qi Long, Yun Li, Can Chen, Tianlong Chen, Nicholas Konz

items.title: Capture of Post-Pluripotency Human Neuromesodermal and Neural Tube Axial Stem Cell States
items.abstract_or_text: The capture of pluripotent and adult tissue stem cells has transformed biomedicine, yet stable stem cell states between these developmental extremes have remained elusive. Here, we capture two human axial stem cell (AxSC) states corresponding to neuromesodermal and derivative neural tube progenitors. These states maintain telomere length without teratoma formation, and neuromesodermal AxSCs were recaptured from human embryonic tail buds. Mechanistically, genome-wide knockout screening and multiomics analyses revealed capture-associated acquisition of a stemness regulatory network with Trithorax-Polycomb dual functionality. Integration with genome-wide DNA methylation analysis identified a novel HOX timer driven by time-grouped DNA demethylation of target genes. Additionally, stage-specific glycolytic/OXPHOS remodeling in AxSCs was linked to bioenergetic pathways and histone acetylation dynamics. Finally, we captured mouse AxSCs that contribute to chimeras and exhibit an evolutionary divergent neuromesodermal-neural combined state. AxSCs are authentic post pluripotent stem cells for upscalable interrogation of development, with potential for regenerative medicine and drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】研究捕获了两种人类轴向干细胞（AxSC）状态，并结合全基因组敲除筛选、多组学、DNA甲基化和小鼠嵌合体实验解析其调控特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为多能与成体组织干细胞之间的发育过渡状态提供了可扩增模型，并有体内与跨物种证据；HOX计时器和Trithorax-Polycomb网络仍需进一步因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 对多能干细胞和成体组织干细胞的捕获已经改变了生物医学，但位于这两个发育极端之间的稳定干细胞状态一直难以获得。在这里，我们捕获了两种人类轴向干细胞（AxSC）状态，分别对应神经中胚层祖细胞及其衍生的神经管祖细胞。这些状态能够维持端粒长度且不形成畸胎瘤；此外，还从人类胚胎尾芽中重新捕获了神经中胚层AxSC。机制上，全基因组敲除筛选和多组学分析显示，捕获相关过程获得了一个具有Trithorax-Polycomb双重功能的干性调控网络。将全基因组DNA甲基化分析整合后，发现一个由按时间分组的靶基因DNA去甲基化驱动的新型HOX计时器。此外，AxSC中的阶段特异性糖酵解/OXPHOS重塑与生物能量通路和组蛋白乙酰化动力学相关。最后，我们捕获了小鼠AxSC；这些细胞能够形成嵌合体，并表现出一种在进化上不同的神经中胚层—神经联合状态。AxSC是真正的多能之后干细胞，可用于可扩增地研究发育，并具有再生医学和药物发现潜力。

items.title: Integrated single-cell transcriptomic analysis reveals KLF6-associated macrophage-alveolar epithelial crosstalk in sepsis-associated acute lung injury
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Sepsis-associated acute lung injury (ALI) contributes substantially to sepsis mortality, but the cellular heterogeneity and molecular regulators driving its progression remain incompletely understood. This study integrated multiple public single-cell transcriptomic datasets to characterize pulmonary cellular remodeling and identify key regulators during sepsis-associated ALI. Methods Mouse lung scRNA-seq datasets (GSE207651, GSE249835, GSE278767; sham and CLP at 12, 24, and 48 h) were integrated with a human PBMC dataset (GSE279452, healthy controls vs. sepsis) and a mouse lung bulk RNA-seq dataset (GSE279484) used for validation. Data were processed in Seurat, with ambient RNA removed via scCDC/DecontX and cell types annotated using CellMarker 2.0. Compositional dynamics were assessed by RO/E ratios, and pathway/M1-M2 activity was scored with decoupleR. Monocyte/macrophage subclusters were characterized using AUCell, GSEApy, and Diffusion Pseudotime analysis. hdWGCNA, pySCENIC, and LIANA were applied to construct co-expression networks, TF regulatory networks, and cell communication maps, respectively; scTenifoldKnk validated candidate TFs in AT2 cells. A CLP mouse model with immunofluorescence staining validated KLF6/CD86 colocalization in vivo. Results Integrated analysis identified major pulmonary populations—including fibroblasts, endothelial cells, epithelial subtypes, and immune lineages that underwent time-dependent remodeling during CLP, particularly within innate immunity. Monocyte/macrophage populations showed pronounced M1/M2 heterogeneity, with M1 scores peaking early and M2 scores rising progressively toward 48 h. Pseudotime analysis revealed a continuous monocyte-to-M1 transition, and hdWGCNA identified associated co-expression modules (M1-M5, M1-M7, M1-M8), nominating Bhlhe40, Glul, and Klf6 as core candidate regulators. Klf6 showed highly specific regulatory activity in M1 macrophages, which communicated with AT2 and endothelial cells via multiple ligand-receptor axes. In PBMCs, a KLF6-high inflammatory monocyte subset was significantly expanded in sepsis and correlated with inflammation score. In AT2 cells, Fli1 and other TFs showed increased activity at CLP24h, with targets linked to vascular and tissue remodeling. Immunofluorescence confirmed increased KLF6⁺CD86⁺ cells in CLP-treated lungs. Conclusions This multi-omic integration delineates the dynamic remodeling of the pulmonary cellular landscape and monocyte/macrophage polarization in sepsis-associated ALI, identifying KLF6 as a key regulator linking macrophage M1 polarization to peripheral inflammatory monocyte activation offering new mechanistic insight and potential therapeutic targets.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】整合多套小鼠和人类单细胞数据，结合网络、转录因子和细胞通信分析，并用CLP小鼠免疫荧光验证KLF6/CD86共定位。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了脓毒症相关急性肺损伤中巨噬细胞—AT2细胞互作的多组学图景和KLF6候选调控线索；现有结果主要是关联性和候选机制，不能单独证明KLF6的因果作用。
items.abstract_zh: 脓毒症相关急性肺损伤（ALI）对脓毒症死亡负担很大，但驱动其进展的细胞异质性和分子调节因子仍未完全阐明。本研究整合多个人类和小鼠公共单细胞转录组数据集，以刻画脓毒症相关ALI期间的肺部细胞重塑并识别关键调节因子。小鼠肺scRNA-seq数据集（GSE207651、GSE249835、GSE278767；假手术和CLP后12、24及48小时）与人类PBMC数据集（GSE279452；健康对照与脓毒症）整合；另用小鼠肺bulk RNA-seq数据集（GSE279484）进行验证。数据在Seurat中处理，使用scCDC/DecontX去除环境RNA，并用CellMarker 2.0进行细胞类型注释。采用RO/E比值评估组成动态，用decoupleR对通路和M1-M2活性评分。单核细胞/巨噬细胞亚群通过AUCell、GSEApy和Diffusion Pseudotime进行表征；分别应用hdWGCNA、pySCENIC和LIANA构建共表达网络、TF调控网络和细胞通信图谱；用scTenifoldKnk在AT2细胞中验证候选TF。最后，在CLP小鼠模型中通过免疫荧光验证KLF6/CD86体内共定位。整合分析识别出成纤维细胞、内皮细胞、上皮细胞亚型和免疫细胞谱系等主要肺部群体；它们在CLP过程中发生了随时间变化的重塑，先天免疫变化尤其明显。单核细胞/巨噬细胞群体表现出显著的M1/M2异质性：M1评分早期达到峰值，M2评分则逐步升高并接近48小时。拟时序分析显示单核细胞持续向M1转变，hdWGCNA识别出相关共表达模块（M1-M5、M1-M7、M1-M8），并提名Bhlhe40、Glul和Klf6为核心候选调节因子。Klf6在M1巨噬细胞中显示出高度特异的调控活性；M1巨噬细胞通过多个配体—受体轴与AT2细胞和内皮细胞通信。在PBMC中，KLF6高表达的炎症性单核细胞亚群在脓毒症中显著扩增，并与炎症评分相关。在AT2细胞中，Fli1及其他TF在CLP24h时活性升高，其靶基因与血管和组织重塑相关。免疫荧光证实CLP处理肺组织中的KLF6⁺CD86⁺细胞增加。结论是，这种多组学整合描绘了脓毒症相关ALI中肺部细胞景观和单核细胞/巨噬细胞极化的动态重塑，识别出连接巨噬细胞M1极化与外周炎症性单核细胞激活的KLF6关键调节线索，并提出潜在治疗靶点。
items.author_line: Tan W, Chokkakula S, Huang H

items.title: Decoding autophagy-immune crosstalk in diabetic kidney disease: CCL2 as a central hub linking autophagic flux to macrophage polarization
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is a leading cause of end-stage renal disease. Autophagy maintains cellular homeostasis but is dysregulated in DKD. Both DKD and autophagy are closely linked to immune responses, yet the mechanistic crosstalk among them remains unclear. Methods We integrated multi‑cohort transcriptomic data and used machine learning to identify five autophagy‑associated feature genes (FOS, JUN, SOD1, CASP3, CCL2), which showed robust diagnostic performance in a training set and three external validation datasets (ROC analysis). Based on these five genes, we identified two autophagy‑related molecular subtypes of DKD with significant differences in immune response intensity and immune checkpoint expression. Single‑cell transcriptomics characterized the expression patterns and interactions of these features across renal cell populations. In DKD mouse models, we validated abnormal expression of the five genes and common autophagy markers by qPCR and Western blot, and demonstrated significant correlations between key features, autophagy indicators, and multiple renal function parameters. Results The five autophagy‑associated genes exhibited strong diagnostic value. The two DKD molecular subtypes differed markedly in immune response and checkpoint gene expression. Single‑cell analysis revealed distinct expression patterns across renal cell types. Animal studies confirmed dysregulation of the five genes and autophagy markers, as well as significant correlations with renal function parameters. Conclusions This study delineates the autophagy landscape in DKD and reveals its connection to immune microenvironment remodeling, providing potential biomarkers and strategic insights for stratified diagnosis and targeted intervention in DKD.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】整合多队列转录组、单细胞分析和DKD小鼠实验，识别FOS、JUN、SOD1、CASP3、CCL2五个自噬相关特征基因及两个分子亚型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把自噬特征与免疫微环境和肾功能指标联系起来，兼有外部数据集和动物验证；五基因诊断表现与免疫关联仍不能等同于已证实的治疗因果链。
items.abstract_zh: 糖尿病肾病（DKD）是终末期肾病的主要原因之一。自噬维持细胞稳态，但在DKD中发生失调。DKD和自噬都与免疫反应密切相关，然而三者之间的机制性交互仍不清楚。我们整合多队列转录组数据并使用机器学习，识别出5个自噬相关特征基因（FOS、JUN、SOD1、CASP3、CCL2）；这些基因在训练集和3个外部验证数据集的ROC分析中均表现出稳健的诊断能力。基于这5个基因，我们识别出两种自噬相关DKD分子亚型，它们在免疫反应强度和免疫检查点表达方面存在显著差异。单细胞转录组学刻画了这些特征在不同肾脏细胞群中的表达模式及相互作用。在DKD小鼠模型中，我们通过qPCR和Western blot验证了这5个基因及常见自噬标志物的异常表达，并证明关键特征、自噬指标和多项肾功能参数之间存在显著相关性。结果显示，这5个自噬相关基因具有较强诊断价值；两种DKD分子亚型在免疫反应和检查点基因表达方面明显不同。单细胞分析揭示了不同肾脏细胞类型中的差异表达模式。动物研究证实了这5个基因和自噬标志物的失调，以及它们与肾功能参数之间的显著相关性。结论是，本研究描绘了DKD中的自噬图谱，揭示其与免疫微环境重塑的联系，并为分层诊断和靶向干预提供潜在生物标志物及策略线索。
items.author_line: Li F, Wu Y, Ling J, Xia P, Liang J, Zheng X, Huang X, Xu M, Zhou Y, Yu P, Shen Y

items.title: A Modality-Invariant Measure of Neural Health
items.abstract_or_text: Quantifying neural health with a single measure remains a major unmet challenge. Here, we report a physiological marker based on the spatial distribution of signal-derived energy correlates in the resting brain. We hypothesize that energy organization in the healthy brain approaches an entropy-maximizing, homeostatically regulated state characterized by five properties: lognormal energy distributions, balanced spatial allocation, statistical independence between regions, low energy variance, and temporal stability. Together, these properties define an energetic profile that the Neural Health Index (NHI) summarizes as a single score, computable from (scalp/intracranial) electroencephalography, magnetoencephalography, or functional magnetic resonance imaging. Across 808 participants spanning neurological, psychiatric, neurodevelopmental, and neurodegenerative disorders, NHI distinguished healthy from clinical populations with sensitivity and specificity exceeding 95% in internal and external validation, scaled with disease severity, tracked pharmacological treatment exposure, and generalized to unseen diagnoses. These findings support NHI as a disease-agnostic, modality-invariant candidate biomarker for disease stratification and treatment monitoring.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】NHI从静息脑信号能量分布构建单一神经健康指标，在808名参与者及内外部验证中区分健康与多类临床人群。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨EEG、MEG和fMRI的统一候选生物标志物具有转化潜力，但当前证据仍是观察性验证，不能据此宣称疾病无关或治疗反应的因果指标。
items.abstract_zh: 用单一指标量化神经健康仍是一个尚未解决的重要挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种基于静息脑中信号衍生能量相关量空间分布的生理标志物。我们假设，健康大脑中的能量组织趋近于熵最大化、受稳态调节的状态，并具有五种性质：对数正态能量分布、平衡的空间分配、区域之间的统计独立性、较低的能量方差和时间稳定性。这些性质共同定义了一个能量特征，神经健康指数（NHI）将其概括为单一分数；该分数可由（头皮/颅内）脑电图、脑磁图或功能性磁共振成像计算。在涵盖神经系统、精神、神经发育和神经退行性疾病的808名参与者中，NHI在内部和外部验证中以超过95%的敏感度和特异度区分健康人群与临床人群；其数值随疾病严重程度变化，能够追踪药物治疗暴露，并推广到未见过的诊断类型。这些结果支持将NHI视为一种与疾病无关、与模态无关的候选生物标志物，用于疾病分层和治疗监测。
items.author_line: Sanchez Colon, L. A., Niebur, E., Kang, J., Onyike, C., Sarma, S.

items.title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
items.abstract_or_text: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】Asymmetric SupCon在3.98百万名台湾NHIRD患者上预训练时间Transformer，并迁移到MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT，评估跨国家EHR表示迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模大、跨体系迁移和目标函数消融较完整，提示非对称对比学习可缩小跨国EHR差距；仍需更多真实部署和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）表示的跨系统迁移很有挑战，因为不同机构和国家在临床编码、患者群体及医疗工作流程方面存在显著差异。我们提出非对称监督式对比学习（Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning，Asymmetric SupCon），这是一种受临床阴性结局异质性启发的任务特异性预训练目标。该目标将具有相同目标阳性结局的患者聚类，而不显式地把阴性轨迹相互吸引。我们在台湾全民健康保险研究数据库（NHIRD）的398万名患者纵向记录上预训练时间Transformer，并将其迁移到两个美国EHR数据集MIMIC-IV和EHRSHOT。一个结合直接映射与基于嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程，实现了异质临床词汇之间的迁移。在MIMIC-IV上，NHIRD预训练相较随机初始化持续改善，并显著缩小与任务特异性域内预训练之间的性能差距。在EHRSHOT上，迁移模型在新发疾病预测的少样本设置中表现尤其突出。受控目标消融显示，Asymmetric SupCon在4个评估任务中的3个上取得最高AUPRC，在第4个任务上比Standard SupCon低0.003 AUPRC。这些结果支持非对称对比预训练作为任务特异性跨国家EHR表示迁移的有效方法。代码见https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon。

items.title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
items.abstract_or_text: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce TrustMed-RL. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】TrustMed-RL在稀有病病例、24,000多个手工标注影像面板和2,500个评估病例上训练长程证据驱动诊断策略，并进行医生轨迹评审。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把问诊、检查、会诊和文献搜索纳入状态依赖动作，兼顾诊断准确率与证据获取；评估仍基于病例和离线轨迹，不能替代临床试验。
items.abstract_zh: 医学语言模型有时能在检查不完整且推理缺乏支持的情况下给出正确诊断。为支持长程、证据驱动的诊断，我们提出TrustMed-RL。该方法基于PubMed稀有病病例和24,000多个手工标注的影像面板构建，将问诊、检查、测试、专科会诊和文献检索通过状态依赖动作整合起来。我们的8B视觉—语言策略使用临床适配的GiGPO和覆盖率调整的诊断奖励进行训练，在2,500个评估病例上达到37.1%的诊断准确率，超过所有评估的开放权重基线，并比监督微调提高12.4个百分点。当成功还要求获取至少50%的支持性检查证据时，TrustMed-RL达到32.5%，比GPT-4o高6.8个百分点。此外，它在MTMedDialog上超过所有评估基线，并在AgentClinic上超过多个更大的27–32B模型。在对200条诊断被接受的测试集轨迹进行医生评审时，83.0%的轨迹获得4–5分（满分5分）的证据支撑评分。医生评价表明，这些诊断轨迹可信，并且与人类诊断推理一致。
items.author_line: Wenxin Zhan, Yizheng Jiao, Haifeng Song, Shuai Xu, Chencheng Pan, Jiayi Feng, Anjie Xie

items.title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
items.abstract_or_text: Structured radiology reporting mitigates the heterogeneity of free-text reports, yet its benefits depend on high-quality reporting templates. In practice, such templates are conventionally built through labor-intensive expert consensus and therefore vary across institutions and lag behind evolving clinical practice. Large language models (LLMs) enable automated template induction, but existing approaches remain limited: single-LLM induction is constrained by context length, and the corpus-scale method ASTAR produces a static, closed-corpus template without external grounding or downstream adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TEMPLAR, a TEMPLate-centric Agentic framework for inducing and evolving standardized Radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora. TEMPLAR treats the template as a persistent central state maintained alongside two provenance-aware knowledge graphs, namely an anatomical graph that constrains template construction and a diagnostic graph that supports finding-to-diagnosis reasoning. Three agents operate on this state. The Induction Agent derives canonical clinical slots from anatomy-constrained Span-Triple atoms via dual-view similarity clustering; the Evolution Agent then assembles these slots into a hierarchical template and revises it under consistency constraints, external clinical evidence, and downstream structuring feedback; and the Clinical Agent applies the evolved template to report structuring, reconstruction, and diagnostic reasoning. Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperforms ASTAR, three medical LLMs, and six general-purpose LLMs in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, while achieving the highest or tied-highest LLM-rated template quality. Its fidelity advantages over ASTAR persist under cross-dataset transfer, and cumulative ablations support complementary contributions of its key components.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】TEMPLAR把模板作为持久中心状态，联合解剖图和诊断图，由诱导、演化、临床三个智能体从大规模影像报告语料中构建并迭代模板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨四个数据集比较多个医学和通用LLM，并报告跨数据集迁移和累积消融，方法创新与可复现性较强；摘要未给出具体数据集规模和绝对指标。
items.abstract_zh: 结构化放射学报告可以缓解自由文本报告的异质性，但其收益取决于高质量报告模板。在实践中，这些模板通常通过耗费大量人工的专家共识构建，因此机构之间差异很大，也滞后于不断演变的临床实践。大型语言模型（LLM）能够自动诱导模板，但现有方法仍有限：单个LLM的诱导受上下文长度限制，语料规模方法ASTAR产生的是静态、封闭语料模板，缺乏外部支撑和下游适应能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出TEMPLAR——一种以模板为中心的智能体框架，用于从大规模临床语料中诱导和演化标准化放射学报告模板。TEMPLAR将模板作为持久的中心状态，并与两个具有来源信息的知识图谱共同维护：解剖图约束模板构建，诊断图支持从发现到诊断的推理。三个智能体在这一状态上运行。诱导智能体从受解剖约束的Span-Triple原子中，通过双视图相似性聚类提取规范化临床槽位；演化智能体随后将这些槽位组装为层级模板，并在一致性约束、外部临床证据和下游结构化反馈下进行修订；临床智能体则应用演化后的模板完成报告结构化、重建和诊断推理。在4个数据集上，TEMPLAR在覆盖率、信息保真度和诊断保真度方面超过ASTAR、3个医学LLM和6个通用LLM，同时获得最高或并列最高的LLM评定模板质量。相较ASTAR的保真度优势在跨数据集迁移时仍然存在，累积消融支持其关键组件的互补贡献。
items.author_line: Xiaotian Hu, Mingxuan Liu, Zhonghan Wang, Xinfeng Zhang, Yiming Huang, Ziang Wang, Kasidit Anmahaepong, Yijin Li, Yifei Chen, Hongjia Yang, Zihan Li, Qiyuan Tian

items.title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
items.abstract_or_text: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】MedPrune将医疗VQA诊断流程建模为异质通信图，通过强化学习驱动的节点和边稀疏化降低多智能体通信拓扑和令牌开销。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时优化协作性能、拓扑复杂度和对抗鲁棒性，针对多智能体医疗推理的可扩展性；摘要未报告数据集规模及具体效率增益。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管医疗多模态大型语言模型（Med-MLLM）推动了医疗视觉问答（VQA）发展，但现有受临床工作流程启发的多智能体框架受到交互模式和冗余通信拓扑造成的过高计算开销影响。本文提出MedPrune，这是一种高效的医疗多模态多智能体协作框架，通过动态从通信拓扑中同时裁剪节点和边，增强推理能力并提高令牌效率。具体而言，我们首先将诊断过程表述为异质通信图，其中节点表示来自不同科室的专科智能体，边表示科室内和科室间的交互。在此图基础上，我们引入两种稀疏化机制以实现自适应协作演化：（1）异质节点稀疏化，利用强化学习驱动的拓扑优化，删除与当前多模态问题无关的专科智能体；（2）异质边稀疏化，通过联合优化任务性能和拓扑复杂度，只保留诊断上最重要的科室内及科室间连接。在完整集和少样本训练设置下的大量医疗VQA实验表明，MedPrune超过多智能体基线，并在保持较强对抗鲁棒性的同时提升令牌效率。
items.author_line: Jiuheng Wan, Runze Li, Chen Chen, Tingyuan Hu, Daiyang Yu, Yimin Jing, Taolin Zhang, Richang Hong

items.title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】该方法把UMLS Concept Unique Identifier集合F1作为软验证器，与熵归一化LLM评审和一致性惩罚结合，在MedQA和PubMedQA上改进生成式临床问答。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用可外部指定的本体重叠奖励捕获实体替换错误，并通过消融和多随机种子验证；收益来自基准任务，尚不能代表临床安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型的强化学习后训练依赖两类奖励设计：人类偏好（RLHF、DPO）和二元验证器（RLVR）。临床问题问答不完全适合其中任何一种。近似正确的答案可能只差一个被替换的实体，而且没有可执行的检查能够判定临床正确性。我们从一个持续维护的受控词汇表中实例化了软验证器：UMLS Concept Unique Identifier重叠（通过scispaCy计算集合级F1）提供一种分级、外部指定的奖励，计算过程中不需要模型参与。我们在GRPO中将其与熵归一化的LLM评审结合；后者覆盖重叠指标无法识别的安全性和证据维度；同时加入一个针对填充和重复的小型一致性惩罚，使早期训练样本仍可评分。在MedQA上，与Phi-3-mini（3.8B）的SFT相比，该三项复合奖励使EM提高2.9%（0.700对0.680），Token-F1提高39%（0.202对0.145）；在Llama-3.2-3B上，相应的EM提高14%，Token-F1提高35%。我们将Token-F1作为主要指标，因为在开放生成规模下，它会为部分正确的临床内容计分，而EM会丢弃这类内容。主表结果是3个随机种子的均值，标准差低于0.005。该方法迁移到PubMedQA时，在相同复合奖励下训练PubMedQA训练集，相比SFT，Phi-3-mini的Token-F1提高22%，Llama-3.2-3B提高17%，无需重新调参。在Phi-3上进行奖励消融，在固定一致性权重下改变评审器—本体划分，结果将3个EM百分点归因于本体项；该项能捕捉评审器无法发现的实体替换。三个阴性结果限制了设计：随机负样本下的DPO在强先验模型上低于SFT，但能帮助最弱先验模型；稀疏神经奖励下的PPO发散；带损失中KL项的GRPO在7B规模时崩溃。

items.title: lisaR: An LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation of biological categories for gene set enrichment analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) turns differential expression results into lists of enriched gene sets. These lists are often long and redundant and span several gene-set collections, which makes their biological interpretation difficult. We present lisaR, an R package that reads previously computed differential expression or differential abundance results, runs GSEA and organises the output with the LISA dictionaries (LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation). The dictionaries place 13,511 gene sets from the three Gene Ontology branches and from curated pathway collections such as Reactome, WikiPathways, KEGG, BioCarta and PID in 158 biological categories grouped into 42 supercategories within four dictionaries. Four open-weight language models scored the semantic fit of each gene set to the categories, and a consensus rule selected the assignments. The dictionaries are distributed with the package and do not depend on the data: studies analysed at different times with the same dictionaries are interpreted with the same categories, and no language model is queried during an analysis. For each category, lisaR summarises the direction of its significant gene sets and applies closed testing with Hommel's robust procedure, which states whether the category shows evidence of enrichment and gives a simultaneous lower bound on how many of its gene sets are enriched. lisaR results are summarised in a report that opens in a web browser and leads from each category to its gene sets and genes, with every figure saved together with its data and R code. We illustrate the workflow with RNA-seq from melanoma biopsies taken before and during nivolumab treatment and with paired tumour and adjacent-tissue proteomics from clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Availability: lisaR is available at https://github.com/DBM-OlmedaLab/lisaR and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23044930; documentation at https://olmedalab.org/lisaR/.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】lisaR用LLM预先为13,511个基因集建立语义类别字典，并在分析时离线组织GSEA结果，配合闭合检验、可追溯报告和可复现代码。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将冗长、冗余的富集结果压缩为可解释层级，同时避免分析过程中再次调用模型；字典质量依赖预先的模型评分和共识规则。
items.abstract_zh: 基因集富集分析（GSEA）将差异表达结果转换为富集基因集列表。这些列表通常很长且存在冗余，并跨越多个基因集集合，使其生物学解释变得困难。我们提出lisaR，这是一个R软件包，读取已经计算的差异表达或差异丰度结果，运行GSEA，并使用LISA字典（LLM-Inferred Semantic Annotation，大语言模型推断的语义注释）组织输出。这些字典将来自3个Gene Ontology分支以及Reactome、WikiPathways、KEGG、BioCarta和PID等整理型通路集合的13,511个基因集，放入158个生物学类别；这些类别分为42个超类别，分布在4个字典中。4个开放权重语言模型为每个基因集与类别的语义匹配度评分，并通过共识规则选择归属。字典随软件包分发且不依赖数据：在不同时间分析的研究使用相同字典时，将以相同类别进行解释，并且分析过程中不查询语言模型。对于每个类别，lisaR汇总其显著基因集的方向，并采用Hommel稳健程序进行闭合检验；该检验判断类别是否存在富集证据，并给出该类别中富集基因集数量的同时下界。lisaR结果汇总为可在网页浏览器中打开的报告，用户可以从每个类别追溯到其基因集和基因；每幅图都会与其数据和R代码一同保存。我们用黑色素瘤活检样本在nivolumab治疗前和治疗期间的RNA-seq，以及透明细胞肾细胞癌配对肿瘤与邻近组织的蛋白质组学，示范了这一流程。可用性：lisaR见https://github.com/DBM-OlmedaLab/lisaR，并存档于https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23044930；文档见https://olmedalab.org/lisaR/。
items.author_line: Velasco-Lopez, C., de la Vega-Barranco, G., Olmeda, D.

items.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Prevalent Cardiovascular Disease Stratification Using Clinical, Sociodemographic, and Lifestyle Data: Temporal Validation in NHANES
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background: Machine-learning methods can capture nonlinear associations in multidomain health data, but discrimination alone does not establish the reliability of probability-based disease stratification. Calibration, temporal transportability, threshold-dependent behavior, subgroup heterogeneity, and model interpretability require separate evaluation. Objective: To develop and temporally validate an explainable machine-learning framework for stratifying prevalent physiciandiagnosed cardiovascular disease (CVD), while evaluating discrimination, probability calibration, decision-analytic behavior, subgroup robustness, and explanation stability. Methods: National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) data from 2007–2018 were analyzed. Adults aged ≥ 20 years with a known composite CVD outcome were included. Prevalent CVD was defined from self-reported physician diagnoses of congestive heart failure, coronary heart disease, angina, heart attack, or stroke. NHANES 2007–2012 constituted the development period and 2013–2018 the chronologically later temporal-validation period. Logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were compared and tuned using development-only five-fold cross-validation. XGBoost was selected according to the predefined development ROC-AUC ranking criterion. A sigmoid calibration mapping and a Youden-derived analytical operating point were established using development data and locked before temporal evaluation. The uncalibrated and isotonic probability outputs were retained as sensitivity analyses. Temporal evaluation included ROC-AUC, average precision, Brier score, log loss, calibration intercept and slope, bootstrap confidence intervals, threshold-dependent metrics, decision-curve analysis, predictor-domain ablation, subgroup analysis, and SHAP-based explainability. Results: The analytical cohort included 34,602 adults: 17,626 in development and 16,976 in temporal validation. The locked sigmoid-calibrated XGBoost achieved a temporal ROC-AUC of 0.847 (95% CI 0.839–0.856) and average precision of 0.403 (95% CI 0.382–0.427), compared with a prevalence baseline of approximately 0.113. The Brier score was 0.083 (95% CI 0.080–0.086), calibration intercept was −0.067 (95% CI −0.164 to 0.038), and calibration slope was 0.981 (95% CI 0.943–1.022). The uncalibrated XGBoost had a lower temporal Brier score (0.0809), indicating that the sigmoid layer did not improve overall probability accuracy. At the development-locked analytical operating point of 0.0760, sensitivity was 0.820, specificity 0.718, positive predictive value 0.270, and negative predictive value 0.969. Operating characteristics varied substantially by age. Age was the dominant SHAP predictor, and original-predictor importance rankings were stable across temporal cycles (pairwise Spearman ρ= 0.982–0.996). Conclusions: The development-locked framework maintained useful discrimination and near-ideal aggregate calibration when transported chronologically to later NHANES cycles, although sigmoid calibration did not improve the Brier score relative to the uncalibrated model. Social-context and lifestyle/exposure variables provided modest incremental predictive information beyond the core clinical-demographic predictors. Because the outcome was prevalent physician-diagnosed CVD rather than prospective cardiovascular events, the model should be interpreted as a prevalent-CVD status-stratification framework rather than a longitudinal event-risk calculator. Independent external and prospective validation, including purpose-specific threshold development, is required before clinical use.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint，临床】在NHANES 2007–2018的34,602名成年人中，锁定开发期的校准XGBoost进行时间验证，并系统评估判别、校准、阈值、亚组和解释稳定性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 报告了时间外推、校准和决策曲线，而非只报AUC；结局是既往医生诊断的患病状态，不是前瞻性事件风险，作者也明确要求独立外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习方法能够捕捉多领域健康数据中的非线性关联，但仅有判别能力并不能证明基于概率的疾病分层可靠。校准、时间可迁移性、依赖阈值的行为、亚组异质性和模型可解释性需要分别评估。目的：开发并进行时间验证一种可解释的机器学习框架，用于分层预测既往由医生诊断的心血管疾病（CVD），同时评估判别能力、概率校准、决策分析行为、亚组稳健性和解释稳定性。方法：分析2007–2018年的National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey（NHANES）数据。纳入年龄≥20岁且具有已知复合CVD结局的成年人。患病CVD根据自报的充血性心力衰竭、冠心病、心绞痛、心脏病发作或卒中医生诊断定义。NHANES 2007–2012作为开发期，2013–2018作为按时间顺序划分的后续时间验证期。比较逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM，并仅使用开发数据进行5折交叉验证调参。根据预先规定的开发期ROC-AUC排序标准选择XGBoost。使用开发数据建立sigmoid校准映射和Youden推导的分析工作点，并在时间评估前锁定。保留未校准和等距回归概率输出作为敏感性分析。时间评估包括ROC-AUC、平均精确率、Brier分数、对数损失、校准截距和斜率、bootstrap置信区间、依赖阈值的指标、决策曲线分析、预测因子领域消融、亚组分析和基于SHAP的可解释性。结果：分析队列包含34,602名成年人：开发集17,626人，时间验证集16,976人。锁定的sigmoid校准XGBoost在时间验证中达到0.847的ROC-AUC（95% CI 0.839–0.856）和0.403的平均精确率（95% CI 0.382–0.427），而患病率基线约为0.113。Brier分数为0.083（95% CI 0.080–0.086），校准截距为−0.067（95% CI −0.164至0.038），校准斜率为0.981（95% CI 0.943–1.022）。未校准XGBoost的时间Brier分数更低（0.0809），表明sigmoid层没有改善总体概率准确度。在开发期锁定的0.0760分析工作点上，敏感度为0.820，特异度为0.718，阳性预测值为0.270，阴性预测值为0.969。工作特征随年龄显著变化。年龄是SHAP中最重要的预测因子，原始预测因子的重要性排序在不同时间周期之间保持稳定（成对Spearman ρ=0.982–0.996）。结论：该开发期锁定框架在按时间迁移到后续NHANES周期时保持了有用的判别能力和近乎理想的总体校准，尽管相对于未校准模型，sigmoid校准并未改善Brier分数。社会背景和生活方式/暴露变量在核心临床—人口学预测因子之外提供了适度的增量预测信息。由于结局是既往由医生诊断的患病CVD，而不是前瞻性心血管事件，该模型应被解释为患病CVD状态分层框架，而不是纵向事件风险计算器。在临床使用前，仍需要独立的外部和前瞻性验证，包括针对具体目的的阈值开发。

review.note: 共审阅60项候选；按早期综合日报身份检查排除1项重复报道（biorxiv:10.64898/2026.09.22.753604）。以下选择均为preprint，并覆盖蛋白质与结构、组学与细胞、生物医学与临床、方法与模型；临床相关条目保留其临床证据边界，不将相关性表述为因果性。
